verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I give You my life
I give You my trust
Jesus

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You are my God
You are enough
Jesus
Oh, Jesus

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
My heart is Yours
My heart is Yours
Take it all, take it all
My life in Your hands

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I lay down my life
And take up my cross
Jesus

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You are my God
Whatever the cost
Jesus
Oh, Jesus

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
All to Jesus I surrender
All to You I freely give
I will ever love and trust You
In Your presence I will live
